verdict: A very close, well-structured rebuild whose biggest miss is the bottom of the screen: the feed under the tab bar is drawn at full contrast instead of fading behind frosted glass, with a few glyph and letter-spacing slips.

top_defects.where: Top read card behind the tab bar (y ≈ 2550–2796)
top_defects.what: reference fades the 3rd row (rank 3, 'Star Academy (France)', description) to a pale grey and blurs the 2nd row under translucent glass; candidate draws row 3 at full contrast and the bars are near-opaque white (heatmap cells of the bottom row 8.7–17.8)

top_defects.where: segmented control, card text, section titles
top_defects.what: uneven letter spacing from the global tracking-[-0.43px] plus per-element tracking: visible gaps in 'Communit y', 'souter rain', 'Which came first?' set wider than the reference

top_defects.where: 'Today', section titles, 'Which came first?', tab icons
top_defects.what: pure #000000 instead of Wikipedia's #202122 main text color

top_defects.where: Games card header, Home tab, profile button, status bar
top_defects.what: outlined Material calendar instead of the filled-header SF calendar with dot grid; rounded Material home instead of the house with chimney; outlined account_circle instead of filled person.crop.circle; cellular bars ~2/3 the reference size
Star Academy logo shown whole and small (object-contain) instead of the reference's tight crop filling the 37 pt square
cellular indicator ~10 px narrower at @3x; segmented control lacks the reference's light glass rim and sits ~1 px higher

strengths: Every block (header buttons, segmented control, 'Card hidden' banner, Games card, Top read card, tab bar) sits within a few px of the reference, with matching radii and soft shadows
All texts exact, including accents and truncation ('présidentiell…', 'Émission française de télé réalité mus…') and the measured palette #3366cc / #72777d / #f8f9fa
Game rows, article rows and tab items are templates over data, the feed is a flex column, layers carry meaningful names
